# SlopeChart

## Overview

`SlopeChart` is a top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `SlopeGroup`, `InlineChartKeyGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete classic **2-pillar slope chart** visualisation. Use it for before/after, year-over-year, or pre/post comparisons where the _change_ between two categories is the story and direct labelling beats a full axis grid.

It follows the **Organized Props Pattern** with two layers: Parent Props (Layer 2) and Child Configs (Layer 3). All design tokens resolve through the CSS cascade (`@layer brand`) — no runtime JS token resolver, no `modes` prop.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `1003:9523`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=1003-9523

## Architecture

```
SlopeChart (wrapper)
├── ChartAccessibility (role="figure", aria-label, aria-describedby, hidden data table, live region)
│   ├── ChartHeader (optional; ChartTitle + ChartSubtitle)
│   ├── ChartLegend (optional; auto-populated from series, or manual `items`)
│   ├── DataDisplay (optional; static values OR live-updating on slope-line hover)
│   │   ├── mainLabel (inline typography tokens)
│   │   ├── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
│   │   └── Badge (change indicator with appearance + value)
│   ├── SlopeGroup (D3 yScale, 2 pillars, N slope lines, optional YAxis/AvgLine/ZeroLine, HoverBadge)
│   │   ├── YAxis (optional, aria-hidden)
│   │   ├── ZeroLine (auto for negative data, aria-hidden)
│   │   ├── AvgLine (optional, aria-hidden)
│   │   ├── SVG slope lines × N series
│   │   ├── HTML endpoint dots
│   │   ├── Category labels (below pillars, aria-hidden)
│   │   └── HoverBadge (cursor-following, aria-hidden)
│   ├── InlineChartKeyGroup (optional; compact per-series legend + values row)
│   └── ChartFooter (annotationLeftValue + annotationRightValue)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { SlopeChart } from './charts/SlopeChart';
import type { SlopeChartProps, SlopeHoverData, SlopeData } from './charts/SlopeChart';
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```typescript
import type { ChartSeriesDataPoint } from '../types/chart-data';

const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: '2010', series: 'Kerala',      value: 93.91 },
  { category: '2023', series: 'Kerala',      value: 96.2  },
  { category: '2010', series: 'Maharashtra', value: 82.34 },
  { category: '2023', series: 'Maharashtra', value: 87.5  },
];
```

Each row is `{ category: string, series: string, value: number }`. Two rows per series (one per pillar).

### Pre-shaped Format

```typescript
import type { SlopeData } from './charts/SlopeChart';

const data: SlopeData = {
  leftCategory: '2010',
  rightCategory: '2023',
  series: [
    { series: 'Kerala',      leftValue: 93.91, rightValue: 96.2  },
    { series: 'Maharashtra', leftValue: 82.34, rightValue: 87.5  },
  ],
};
```

SlopeChart synthesizes canonical `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` internally for ChartAccessibility and InlineChartKeyGroup.

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<SlopeChart
  data={[
    { category: '2010', series: 'Kerala',      value: 93.91 },
    { category: '2023', series: 'Kerala',      value: 96.2  },
    { category: '2010', series: 'Maharashtra', value: 82.34 },
    { category: '2023', series: 'Maharashtra', value: 87.5  },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Literacy Rate',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Indian states, 2010 vs 2023',
  }}
  slopeGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
    hoverType: 'individual',
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Census of India',
  }}
/>
```

## Props Reference

### Layer 2 — Parent Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `data` | `ChartSeriesDataPoint[] \| SlopeData` | — | Chart data (required). |
| `seriesOrder` | `string[]` | — | Explicit series ordering (overrides detection). |
| `categoryOrder` | `[CategoryValue, CategoryValue]` | — | Explicit `[left, right]` category order. |
| `width` | `number \| string` | `328` | Total chart width. |
| `height` | `number \| string` | `400` | Total chart height — SlopeGroup fills remaining space. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch to fill parent container width. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable hover/keyboard interactivity on slope lines. |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable clip-path entry animation on first load. |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true` | Show ChartHeader slot. |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `true` | Show ChartLegend slot. |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Show DataDisplay KPI slot above SlopeGroup. |
| `inlineChartKeyGroup` | `boolean` | `false` | Show InlineChartKeyGroup slot below SlopeGroup. |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true` | Show ChartFooter slot. |

### Layer 3 — Child Configs

| Prop | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `chartHeaderConfig` | `{ chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue, subtitle }` | ChartHeader props. |
| `chartLegendConfig` | `{ items, interactiveDataHead, formatHoverSupportingLabel, size }` | ChartLegend props. |
| `dataDisplayConfig` | `DataDisplayConfig` | DataDisplay props + hover-mode behaviour. |
| `slopeGroupConfig` | `SlopeGroupConfig` | SlopeGroup props (yAxis, avgLine, hoverBadge, etc.). |
| `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig` | `{ items, chartData, defaultType, defaultShapeIndicator, defaultMainData, defaultSupportingData, size }` | InlineChartKeyGroup props. |
| `chartFooterConfig` | `{ annotationLeft, annotationLeftValue, annotationRight, annotationRightValue }` | ChartFooter props. |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | ChartAccessibility props. |

## DataDisplay Configuration

### Static Mode (default)

```tsx
<SlopeChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: 'Kerala literacy rate',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '96.2%',
      dataSupportingValue: '↑ 2.3pp since 2010',
    },
    showBadge: true,
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '+2.3pp',
      appearance: 'positive',
      variant: 'tinted',
    },
  }}
/>
```

### Hover Mode

When `mode: 'hover'`, the `mainLabelValue`, `dataHead.dataLeadValue`, and `badgeConfig.value` update dynamically as slope lines are hovered.

```tsx
<SlopeChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: '—',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '—',
      dataSupportingValue: 'Hover a slope line',
    },
    showBadge: true,
    // Controls the badge value in hover mode:
    // "delta-pct"       → "+X.X%" delta between left and right values (default)
    // "endpoint-pct"    → hovered endpoint value with "%" suffix
    // "endpoint-value"  → hovered endpoint value via toLocaleString()
    dataBadgeHoverMode: 'delta-pct',
    // Custom formatters take precedence when provided:
    formatHoverLeadValue: (hover) => `${hover.rightValue.toFixed(1)}%`,
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (hover) => `+${(hover.rightValue - hover.leftValue).toFixed(1)}pp`,
  }}
/>
```

### DataDisplayConfig API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `mode` | `'static' \| 'hover'` | `'static'` | Controls whether values are static or update on slope-line hover. |
| `mainLabelValue` | `string` | — | Label above the lead value. |
| `type` | `'Left' \| 'Center'` | — | Layout alignment. |
| `size` | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'` | — | Typography size variant. |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean` | — | Show the supporting content wrapper. |
| `badgeTop` | `boolean` | — | Pin badge to top slot. |
| `badgeBottom` | `boolean` | — | Pin badge to bottom slot. |
| `showBadge` | `boolean` | — | Show the OneUI Badge in supporting slots. |
| `supportingBadgeLabel` | `boolean` | — | Show supporting badge label. |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue` | `string` | — | Text for supporting badge label. |
| `dataHead` | `DataHeadConfig` | — | DataHead component config (`dataLeadValue`, `dataSupportingValue`, etc.). |
| `badgeConfig` | `BadgeConfig` | — | Badge config (`value`, `appearance`, `variant`, `valueFormat`, `autoDetect`, `start`). |
| `dataBadgeHoverMode` | `'delta-pct' \| 'endpoint-pct' \| 'endpoint-value'` | `'delta-pct'` | Hover-mode badge value calculation strategy. |
| `formatHoverLeadValue` | `(hover: SlopeHoverData) => string` | — | Custom formatter for lead value in hover mode. |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(hover: SlopeHoverData) => string` | — | Custom formatter for badge value in hover mode (overrides `dataBadgeHoverMode`). |

## SlopeGroup Configuration

```tsx
<SlopeChart
  data={data}
  slopeGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    avgLine: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
    hoverType: 'individual', // 'individual' | 'categorical'
    yAxisConfig: {
      tickCount: 5,
      formatValue: (v) => `${v}%`,
      yAxisLabel: true,
      yAxisLabelValue: 'Literacy (%)',
    },
    categoryLabelsConfig: {
      leftLabelValue: 'Census 2010',
      rightLabelValue: 'Census 2023',
    },
    dotConfig: { show: true },
    avgLineConfig: { label: 'National average' },
  }}
/>
```

## ChartLegend — Auto-generation

When `chartLegend={true}` and no manual `chartLegendConfig.items` are provided, the legend is auto-generated from distinct series names in `data`. Colors are assigned from the DataVis categorical palette:

```
color[i] = var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{i+1})
```

These tokens are injected at `@layer brand` by `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection`. There is no runtime JS token resolver — all color resolution happens in the CSS cascade.

## InlineChartKeyGroup

```tsx
<SlopeChart
  data={data}
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  // InlineChartKeyGroup receives the canonical data points and transforms
  // them internally. No manual data pre-processing needed.
/>
```

The legend's per-series values are formatted via `slopeGroupConfig.yAxisConfig.valueFormat` when set — the same format that drives the Y-axis tick labels, so the two stay in sync without a separate legend-specific format prop.

Or supply pre-formatted items:

```tsx
<SlopeChart
  data={data}
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    items: [
      { color: 'var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)', label: 'Kerala', value: '96.2%' },
      { color: 'var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)', label: 'Maharashtra', value: '87.5%' },
    ],
  }}
/>
```

## Accessibility

```tsx
<SlopeChart
  data={data}
  accessibility={{
    enabled: true,
    ariaLabel: 'Slope chart comparing literacy rates between 2010 and 2023',
    summary: 'All states improved between 2010 and 2023. Kerala maintained the highest rate.',
    dataTable: true, // renders a visually-hidden HTML table for screen readers
  }}
/>
```

Hover interactions update an ARIA live region with the hovered series name and values, so keyboard/AT users receive equivalent feedback.

## Performance Notes

All token resolution occurs in the CSS cascade — `@layer brand` is injected once by `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection`. The component itself does no runtime token lookup.

Memoization boundaries:
- `detectSeriesInfo` / `toCanonicalPoints` — re-run only when `data` or `seriesOrder` changes.
- `computedDisplayProps` — re-runs only when hover state or DataDisplay config changes.
- `resolvedLegendItems` — re-runs only when `legendItems`, `detectedSeriesInfo`, or `getCatColor` changes.

For datasets above ~50 series, consider using `seriesOrder` to limit the rendered set.
